blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Wednesday said it would exercise maximum tolerance during protests expected to coincide with the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. urged protest organizers to heed the appeal of the Asean National Organizing Council’s security officials to defer their public assemblies until after the high-stakes regional meeting. He said deployed personnel were ready “to respond to any action that will disrupt the event.” The 49th Asean Summit, scheduled for Nov. 15 to 17, will gather leaders and delegations from the 11 member states, as […]...
